en: Dependent on a state that is not subject to cankers (*nasaraṇa*), a state that is not subject to cankers arises by way of root condition … one.
Dependent on a state that is without conflict (*naaraṇa*), a state that is without conflict arises by way of root condition … three.
Dependent on a state that is both not subject to cankers and without conflict, a state that is not subject to cankers arises by way of root condition … one. (Abbreviated.)
In the case of the root condition, there are five; in the object condition, two ... [and so on] ... in the ripening condition, one ... [and so on] ... in the non-disappearance condition, five.
